This is a multi-branch chain (Point Loma, Pacific Beach/Garnet Ave, Convoy St/Kearny Mesa all separately listed) - found a SinglePlatform listing (places.singleplatform.com/cali-banh-mi-0/menu) with a full priced JSON-LD menu using the same non-browser extraction technique as Monkey Bar, but its embedded address is '2830 Garnet Ave #100' (Pacific Beach), not this restaurant's '3960 W Point Loma Blvd' - wrong branch, discarded per chain-branch identity rule. Confirmed DoorDash (doordash.com/store/cali-banh-mi-san-diego-1484180) and Postmates/UberEats listings exist and match the Point Loma address exactly, but DoorDash's HTML ships only the GraphQL query schema (persisted-query definitions), no populated item/price data - it is client-fetched after load; UberEats returned an empty 307 redirect to a non-fetchable client route. Both require a real browser to render.

name: Family Golden Palace
blocked: no-second-source: no first-party website, no DoorDash/Uber Eats listing found for this Middle Eastern/Mediterranean restaurant at 820 Jamacha Rd, El Cajon. Only one tier-5 aggregator reachable with a full priced menu: allmenus.com (Grubhub network) - 54 items across Appetizers/Breakfast/Drinks/Chicken/Others/Special/Sandwich sections, prices $1.00-$56.99, page dated 2023 (stale caveat per playbook). Tried to find an independent second source per playbook rule (tier-5 needs 2 independent-owner sources): zmenu.com returned HTTP 403, family-golden-palace.wheree.com is Cloudflare-gated (JS challenge), restaurantjump.com 404'd. Per playbook line 146 ('If only one tier-5 source is reachable, say so and mark blocked'), holding this as blocked rather than filing on a single uncorroborated allmenus mirror.

name: Grovers Tavern
notes: No first-party website, no DoorDash/Uber Eats/Grubhub listing found for this small dive bar (3315 Buena Vista Ave, Lemon Grove - pool tables, darts, wrap-around bar per reviews). Checked every aggregator search turned up: restaurantguru.com (200, stripped to 3152 chars) has zero itemized menu, only review text with vague per-person spend estimates ('Price per person: $20-30'); zmenu.com and family-golden-palace-style wheree/similar are Cloudflare JS-gated (403/'Just a moment...'); bippermedia.com redirected to an empty page (301, 0 bytes); groupon/atly/wanderlog/happyhourfinder/restaurantji all reviews-and-hours only in the initial search snippets, no menu section visible. No evidence any itemized per-item price list exists online for this bar anywhere. not_found per playbook ('no itemized per-item pricing anywhere').

name: Culture Craft Coffee & Espresso
notes: Coffee kiosk inside the Lexus Escondido dealership (The Centre of Escondido), 1205 Auto Park Way. First-party domain culturecraftcoffee.com is dead: HTTPS fails with a cert/SNI mismatch (SEC_E_WRONG_PRINCIPAL), and the HTTP fallback returns a generic 164-byte hosting-provider error page ('Page cannot be displayed'), so no first-party source exists despite RestaurantGuru linking to it. No DoorDash/Uber Eats/Grubhub listing found. Used RestaurantGuru's dedicated menu page, explicitly labeled 'Menu from owner a year ago' (restaurant-submitted, same tier-4 category as SinglePlatform per playbook - capped at medium, treat as possibly stale). Extracted 47 priced lines across 3 sections (Hot Beverages, Blended Drinks, Lemonades), md/lg size variants split into separate lines; 2 items (Cappuccino, Americano) and a trailing 'White Mocha' repeat under Blended Drinks had no price shown on the source page and were excluded rather than guessed. Note a likely owner data-entry duplicate: 'Vanilla Kona Mocha' appears once under Hot Beverages ($4.75/$5.25) and again under Blended Drinks at different prices ($4.35/$4.95) - kept both as separate line items labeled by section since the source lists them separately, but this may be the same drink misfiled. Raw-conventional test: 46/47 (98%) land on whole/quarter/half/95-cent boundaries (22 x .25, 17 x .75, 5 x .50, 1 x .00, 1 x .95); the lone outlier is the $4.35 half of that duplicate Vanilla Kona Mocha entry - an isolated value, not a markup pattern. Genuine pricing, no divisor test needed.

name: Refresh Coffee
notes: This location (13520 Evening Creek Dr N, San Diego/Rancho Bernardo, CA 92128) is a permanently closed branch of a small multi-location chain. Batch's listed website (refreshcoffee.co) returns HTTP 404 (confirmed via router cache HIT). Web search confirms Yelp lists this exact address as 'REFRESH COFFEE - CLOSED' (4.6 stars, 27 reviews, established 2010), status current as of a May 2026 Yelp update. Yelp itself is bot-walled (403) so the closure notice comes from the search snippet rather than a direct fetch, but it is specific and address-matched, and is corroborated by the dead first-party domain. Other Refresh Coffee branches remain open elsewhere (e.g. an active UberEats listing for 'Refresh Coffee (Alvarado Rd)'), but per the chain-branch identity rule a sibling branch's menu cannot substitute for this closed one. not_found per playbook (permanently closed business).

name: Cui Daore
blocked: needs-browser: no listed website in batch; found the restaurant's own ordering platform at cui-daore.menufyy.com (Menufy), which is its tier-2 own-ordering-platform source, but every request (root, with/without explicit Accept header) returns HTTP 200 behind Cloudflare with a genuinely empty body (0 bytes on disk despite curl reporting SIZE:9/19 - same discrepancy pattern seen with Dr. Juice's res-menu.net) - a client-side-rendered SPA that ships no content to a non-browser client. No DoorDash/Uber Eats/Grubhub listing found in web search. Other sources found (atly.com directory, 1001poki.com [404], Facebook page) have no itemized per-item prices - atly only gives a vague 'special rolls cost around $20' remark from aggregated review sentiment, not a menu.
